gaps.explanation: Negative infinitive: promised not to be late — 'not' goes before 'to'.

gaps.sentence: You should stop ___ so much coffee late at night.
gaps.explanation: stop + -ing = end the activity: stop drinking coffee.

gaps.sentence: He spent hours ___ to fix the printer.
I can't imagine ___ in a tiny village again.
I didn't mean ___ you — it was a joke.
gaps.explanation: mean (= intend) takes the to-infinitive: didn't mean to upset. (mean + -ing = involve.)

gaps.sentence: She forgot ___ the email, so she sent it twice.
gaps.explanation: forget + -ing = lose the memory of a past action (she did send it).

gaps.sentence: He's considering ___ his job and travelling for a year.
I look forward to ___ your suggestions at the meeting.
